label: X
what: Recent mentions of you and how your latest posts did.

credentials.label: Bearer token
credentials.help: The app's bearer token from the X developer portal. It is read only here.
credentials.looks: A very long string that often starts with many capital A letters

credentials.label: Your numeric user id
credentials.help: The number for your account, not your @name.

reads: Your latest posts with their counts: impressions, likes, replies, reposts and quotes.
scopes: Read access only. Quarterdeck never posts, likes, follows or deletes.
steps: Open the X developer portal and sign in with your account.
Check which access plan you have and what it costs. X's access tiers and prices change and may cost money, so read their current page first.
Create a project and an app, and generate a bearer token for it.
Find your numeric user id. The portal or a lookup in the API shows it. It is digits, not your @name.
Enter the bearer token and the user id here and save each one. Then switch X on.
If X answers that your plan does not include this, the page says so. Nothing else is tried.
revoke: In the X developer portal regenerate or delete the bearer token, or delete the app. Then remove the fields here.
tested: Parsing tested against sample data only. X's plans and endpoint access change. Not tested against the real service.
